headlines.title: 上海：上半年社会融资规模增加6914亿元 上半年本外币贷款增加5315亿元
headlines.summary: 人民银行上海总部7月29日召开2026年第三季度新闻发布会，介绍今年上半年上海金融运行情况，并回答记者提问。上半年，全市社会融资规模增加6914亿元，较好满足了实体经济的融资需求。6月末，全市本外币贷款余额13.60万亿元，同比增长5.9%。

headlines.title: 中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》
headlines.summary: 《通知》协同推进科技金融领域数据开发利用，发布《全国科技金融领域数据开发利用目录1.0》，涵盖企业名单与科创属性、进出口、投融资、经营、研发投入、知识产权、创新能力评价、企业需求等8大类、26个数据指标。支持各地形成具有区域特色的科技金融数据开发利用清单，建设省级科技金融领域数据开发利用配套信息设施，加强现有信息系统资源互联互通，促进数据信息归集共享。坚持统筹发展与安全，规范科技公共数据开发利用，加强全过程安全管理，切实防范各种数据风险。

headlines.title_en: Nine departments including PBOC jointly issued a notice on strengthening data development and use in sci-tech finance
headlines.summary_en: The Notice promotes data development in sci-tech finance, releasing the National Sci-Tech Finance Data Development Catalog 1.0, covering 8 categories and 26 data indicators including enterprise lists, innovation attributes, trade, financing, operations, R&D, IP, innovation capability assessments, and enterprise demands. It supports regions in forming localized sci-tech finance data development lists, building provincial supporting information facilities, enhancing system interconnectivity, and promoting data aggregation. It emphasizes balancing development and security, standardizing sci-tech public data use, and strengthening full-process security management to prevent data risks.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...
headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: ChiNext rebounds, up 1.55%; consumer sectors rally broadly
headlines.summary_en: 1, Overall trend: Market rebounded after intraday lows, with all three major indices rallying. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,200 stocks in the black across the three boards. Turnover reached CNY 2.31 trillion. At close, Shanghai Composite rose 0.4%, Shenzhen Component rose 1.1%, ChiNext rose 1.55%. 2, Sectors: Food, dairy, retail, gaming led gains; lithography, memory chips, advanced packaging, glass substrates lagged. 3, Hot themes: Food, dairy, retail consumer stocks strengthened collectively, with Huanlejia, Liziyuan, Dongbai Group hitting daily limits. Gaming stocks fluctuated higher, with Dianhun Network, Kaiying Network, and Giant Network hitting limits. Auto OEM sector rebounded, with BAIC BluePark hitting limit up. Securities and other financials rose in afternoon, with Hualin Securities hitting limit down. On the downside, lithography concept stocks adjusted, with MLOptic and Kinglai Tech falling over 10%.

headlines.summary: 中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》。《通知》坚持加强科技金融领域数据开放共享和融合运用，支持科技信息使用机构规范运用科技公共数据，鼓励地方向科技型企业提供授权开放信息渠道，推广信息查询、联合建模等模式。开展科技金融可信数据空间创新发展试点，鼓励有条件的地区加强企业收支流水数据开放利用，搭建行业研究信息交流平台，实现科技金融领域数据资源跨域共享和高效对接。支持市场化征信机构建设科技型企业数据库，丰富征信产品和服务供给。

headlines.title_en: Nine departments: launch pilot for trusted data space innovation in sci-tech finance, encourage regions to open enterprise cash flow data
headlines.summary_en: Nine departments including PBOC jointly issued a notice on strengthening data development in sci-tech finance. It emphasizes enhancing open sharing and integrated use of sci-tech finance data, supporting authorized use of sci-tech public data, encouraging local provision of authorized open information channels to sci-tech firms, and promoting models like information query and joint modeling. It pilots innovative development of trusted data spaces for sci-tech finance, encourages regions to open and utilize enterprise cash flow data, builds industry research information exchange platforms, and facilitates cross-domain sharing and efficient docking of sci-tech finance data resources. It supports market-oriented credit agencies in building sci-tech enterprise databases to enrich credit products and services.

headlines.title: 九部门：引导金融机构依托科技金融领域数据库，打造特色的科技型企业风控投研模型
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》。《通知》围绕完善数据赋能科技金融全链条，聚焦融资对接、智能风控、产品创新等环节，引导金融机构依托科技金融领域数据库，构建科技型企业数字信用画像，打造特色的科技型企业风控投研模型，开发契合细分行业企业融资需求的科技金融产品。鼓励金融机构与相关部门合作，运用交易集中度、交易对手分布、交易对手稳定性等数据，开展产业链资金流动分析，绘制重点产业链图谱，“一链一策”精准匹配金融资源。

headlines.title_en: Nine departments: guide financial institutions to build tailored risk control and investment models for tech firms using sci-tech finance databases
headlines.summary_en: Nine departments including PBOC jointly issued a notice on strengthening data development in sci-tech finance. It focuses on improving the data-enabled sci-tech finance chain, targeting financing matching, intelligent risk control, and product innovation. It guides financial institutions to build digital credit profiles for sci-tech firms using sci-tech finance databases, create tailored risk-control and research models for sci-tech firms, and develop sci-tech finance products meeting sub-sector financing needs. It encourages collaboration with departments to use data on transaction concentration, counterparty distribution, and stability for industry chain cash flow analysis, mapping key industry chains, and precisely matching financial resources per chain.

headlines.title: 瑞银CEO认为未来市场将继续出现波动性“飙升”
headlines.summary: 瑞银集团首席执行官Sergio Ermotti在接受采访时表示，他预计今年剩余时间里“波动性飙升”还将继续。“从宏观形势、地缘政治局势、当前的争论，以及我们在股市中看到的巨大分化来看，能源价格面临的压力可能会给通胀带来潜在的逆风”。Ermotti表示投资者不会喜欢这种波动，“我确实预计在今年剩余时间里波动性将继续飙升”。

headlines.title_en: UBS CEO expects future market volatility to 'surge'
headlines.summary_en: UBS CEO Sergio Ermotti said in an interview he expects 'volatility spikes' to continue through the rest of the year. 'From macro conditions, geopolitical situation, current debates, and big divergences seen in stock markets, energy price pressures could bring potential headwinds to inflation.' Ermotti said investors won't like this volatility. 'I do expect volatility to continue to spike for the rest of the year.'

headlines.title: 《北京市扩大文化和旅游新消费奖励办法》发布

headlines.title_en: Beijing releases measures to boost cultural and tourism consumption
headlines.summary_en: July 29, from Beijing Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism: To further unleash cultural and tourism consumption potential and leverage fiscal funds' guiding role, the Beijing Measures for Rewarding New Cultural and Tourism Consumption have been formally issued to deepen integration and drive high-quality development. Regarding application and review, the Measures specify full-chain management from application, initial review, final review, public notice, to fund disbursement, ensuring transparent and accurate reward funds. Applicants must have independent legal personality, no major violations in past three years, and projects must have good economic and social benefits. The Measures aim to stimulate innovation vitality of travel agencies and cultural tourism enterprises, fostering new consumption formats, models, and scenarios, and promoting city-wide.

headlines.title: 外交部回应美国实施先进机器人进口限制
headlines.summary: 针对美国联邦通信委员会宣布对外国制造的先进机器人实施进口限制，包括中方占有主导地位的人形机器人，外交部发言人毛宁7月29日在例行记者会上说，中方一贯坚决反对美方泛化国家安全概念打压中国企业。保护主义提升不了美国的竞争力，只会损害美国企业和消费者的利益。中方将继续采取必要措施，坚定维护中国企业的正当合法权益。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry responds to US advanced robot import restrictions
headlines.summary_en: In response to the US FCC's import restrictions on advanced robots, including humanoid robots dominated by China, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said on July 29 that China firmly opposes US overstretching national security to suppress Chinese companies. Protectionism will not boost US competitiveness but will only harm US firms and consumers. China will continue taking necessary measures to safeguard its firms' legitimate rights and interests.

headlines.title: 获刑15年 国家发展改革委原党组成员、副主任徐宪平一审宣判
headlines.summary: 据央视，2026年7月29日，内蒙古自治区赤峰市中级人民法院一审公开宣判国家发展和改革委员会原党组成员、副主任徐宪平受贿一案，对被告人徐宪平以受贿罪判处有期徒刑十五年，并处罚金人民币五百万元；对徐宪平犯罪所得财物依法予以追缴，上缴国库。

headlines.title_en: Xu Xianping, former deputy director of NDRC, sentenced to 15 years in first trial
headlines.summary_en: By CCTV, July 29, 2026: Chifeng Intermediate People's Court of Inner Mongolia held a first-instance public sentencing of Xu Xianping, former Party member and deputy director of the National Development and Reform Commission. Xu was sentenced to 15 years in prison for bribery and fined CNY 5 million; proceeds from his crimes were confiscated and turned over to the state treasury.

headlines.title: 我国消费金融公司去年共发放个人消费贷款5.24万亿元
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月29日讯，中国银行业协会日前发布《中国消费金融公司发展报告（2026）》。报告显示，目前我国共有消费金融公司31家，总资产规模达1.48万亿元，同比增长7.18%；2025年末贷款余额达1.43万亿元，同比增长6.85%。全年发放个人消费贷款达5.24万亿元，服务客户5.81亿人次。创新推出255款专属产品，新增放款2786亿元，惠及客户3830万人次。

headlines.title_en: China's consumer finance companies issued CNY 5.24 trillion in personal consumer loans last year
headlines.summary_en: July 29 (Jin10 Data): China Banking Association released the 2026 China Consumer Finance Company Development Report. There are 31 consumer finance companies in China, with total assets of CNY 1.48 trillion, up 7.18% YoY. End-2025 loan balance reached CNY 1.43 trillion, up 6.85% YoY. Full-year personal consumer loans issued totaled CNY 5.24 trillion, serving 581 million customers. 255 specialty products were launched, with new loans of CNY 278.6 billion, benefiting 38.3 million customer visits.

headlines.title: 国家烟草专卖局约谈爱奇迹（深圳）技术有限公司
headlines.summary: 针对日常监管中发现的爱奇迹（深圳）技术有限公司涉嫌违法违规生产经营、合规管理薄弱等突出问题，近日，国家烟草专卖局依法对爱奇迹（深圳）技术有限公司负责人进行了行政约谈，要求其严格遵守《中华人民共和国烟草专卖法》、《中华人民共和国烟草专卖法实施条例》及《电子烟管理办法》等规定和国家限制类产业政策，切实履行合规经营主体责任，严格落实电子烟监管要求，建立健全内部合规管理体系，全面提升企业管理水平。（烟草微报微信公号）

headlines.title_en: State Tobacco Monopoly Administration summons AiQiji (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. for talks
headlines.summary_en: Regarding irregularities found in daily supervision of Aiqigi (Shenzhen) Technology Co., including suspected illegal production and weak compliance management, the State Tobacco Monopoly Administration recently held an administrative talk with its principals, requiring strict compliance with the Tobacco Monopoly Law, its implementation regulations, and E-Cigarette Management Measures, as well as national restricted industry policies. The company must fulfill its main responsibility for compliance, strictly implement e-cigarette regulatory requirements, establish internal compliance management systems, and comprehensively improve management levels.

headlines.title: 宽基ETF连续两天成交千亿，中证1000、科创50交易升温
headlines.summary: 宽基ETF成交继续放量，在前一日成交额站上千亿元基础上，全天成交额再度放量至1097亿元，23只产品成交额超过10亿元。科创50ETF华夏、创业板ETF易方达交投最为活跃，成交额双双突破124亿元。与此同时，多只中证1000ETF成交额显著升温，中证1000ETF南方全天成交超80亿元，环比大增52%；华夏、广发、易方达基金旗下的同类产品成交额均较前一交易日增长50%以上。（一财）

headlines.title_en: Broad-based ETFs see 100-billion-yuan turnover for two consecutive days; CSI 1000 and STAR 50 trading heats up
headlines.summary_en: Broad-based ETF trading volume continued to surge. After exceeding 100 billion yuan the previous day, total full-day turnover further expanded to 109.7 billion yuan, with 23 products posting over 10 billion yuan each. The most active were ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF and E Fund ChiNext ETF, both with volumes exceeding 12.4 billion yuan. Meanwhile, multiple CSI 1000 ETFs saw notable volume increases: China Southern CSI 1000 ETF recorded over 8 billion yuan in full-day turnover, a surge of 52% sequentially; similar products from ChinaAMC, GF, and E Fund also saw daily turnover grow over 50% from the prior session. (Yicai)

headlines.title: 南向资金今日大幅净卖出55.89亿元
headlines.summary: 南向资金今日大幅净卖出55.89亿元。港股通（沪）方面，小米集团-W、中芯国际分别获净卖出15.35亿港元、7.69亿港元；阿里巴巴-W净买入额居首，金额为7.84亿港元；港股通（深）方面，中芯国际、美团-W分别获净卖出12.39亿港元、8.32亿港元；腾讯控股净买入额居首，金额为7.34亿港元。

headlines.title_en: Southbound funds record significant net selling of 5.589 billion yuan today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital registered a net sell-off of HK$5.589 billion today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect side, Xiaomi Corp-W and SMIC recorded net sells of HK$1.535 billion and HK$769 million respectively, while Alibaba-W led net buying at HK$784 million. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect side, SMIC and Meituan-W saw net sells of HK$1.239 billion and HK$832 million respectively, while Tencent Holdings ranked first in net buying at HK$734 million.
